phrases.text: I'm here because my back hurts.
phrases.translation: Я здесь, потому что у меня болит спина.
phrases.transliteration: айм хиэ бикоз май бэк хёртс
phrases.description: You say this at the start of the visit to explain the reason for coming.
phrases.example: I'm here because my back hurts, and it's getting worse.
phrases.example_translation: Я здесь, потому что у меня болит спина, и становится хуже.

phrases.text: It hurts in my lower back.
phrases.transliteration: ит хёртс ин май лоуэр бэк
phrases.description: You say this to show the exact place of the pain in the back.
phrases.example: It hurts in my lower back, on the left side.
phrases.example_translation: У меня болит в пояснице, с левой стороны.

phrases.text: It's been like this for a week.
phrases.transliteration: итс бин лайк зис фор э уик
phrases.description: You say this when the doctor asks how long the problem has lasted.
phrases.example: It's been like this for a week, and my lower back still hurts.
phrases.example_translation: Это продолжается уже неделю, и поясница всё ещё болит.

phrases.text: It feels worse when I stand up.
phrases.transliteration: ит филз вёрс уэн ай стэнд ап
phrases.description: You say this to give one simple detail about when the problem is stronger.
phrases.example: It feels worse when I stand up after a long time.
phrases.example_translation: Становится хуже, когда я встаю после долгого времени.

words.description: The part of your body from your neck down to your waist behind you.
words.example: My back hurts when I stand up.
words.example_translation: У меня болит спина, когда я встаю.

words.description: The area at the bottom of the back, above the hips.
words.example: The pain is in my lower back.

words.description: An unpleasant feeling in your body when something hurts.
words.example: The pain started about a week ago.
My back has been hurting for a week now.
words.example_translation: Спина болит у меня уже неделю.

words.description: More difficult, more serious, or more painful than before.
words.example: The pain gets worse in the evening.
